audit.title: Saudi Arabia — Comprehensive National Open Investment Sources Discovery & Coverage Audit
audit.scope: Read-only public-source discovery; no adapters, syncs, Master creation, source-row changes, Master-link changes, UI/map changes, or business-data changes.
audit.search_saturation_qualification: Practical national saturation confirmed after the unresolved candidate endpoints were either verified as public structured catalogs or classified as externally restricted. This is not a mathematical completeness claim.
audit.count_semantics: Source.last_record_count / latest sync parsed count / current raw SourceOpportunity rows / canonical Masters are distinct quantities. Do not treat stored historical rows as current active public listings.

counts.estimated_additional_opportunities: 3 confirmed title-level nonmatches for RCJY; 165 further current provider records across RCU (6) and NCP Investors Portal (159) remain subject to cross-source identity reconciliation. Tourism map volume is unknown. Ta’adeen has 8 inactive historical site records, not current offers.

source_classification_definitions.INTEGRATED: Configured in the live source registry; this status does not assert full current harvest.
source_classification_definitions.READY_TO_INTEGRATE: Public, official, itemized opportunities and a viable public extraction path were directly confirmed.
source_classification_definitions.NEEDS_TECHNICAL_INVESTIGATION: Official public itemization appears to exist, but public list/detail/API access or stable count is incomplete; no bypass attempted.
source_classification_definitions.MIRROR_OF_EXISTING_SOURCE: Issuer's itemized offers appear in an existing national or configured source; no separate adapter recommended without unique records/fields.
source_classification_definitions.NOT_ITEMIZED: Investment interest, strategy, site inventory, news count, or process found but no open actionable itemized catalog.
source_classification_definitions.NOT_INVESTMENT_OPPORTUNITY: Financing or ordinary procurement, not investable assets/concessions/PPP/leases.
source_classification_definitions.RESTRICTED: Potential itemized inventory is behind login/access control and cannot be inspected publicly.
source_classification_definitions.INACTIVE_OR_BROKEN: The only relevant public listing route is inactive or broken and no alternate public path was confirmed.
source_classification_definitions.NO_CURRENT_OPPORTUNITIES: A source exposes a catalog pathway, but no current itemized offer is displayed.
